scripts.api:dev: uv run --project apps/api --locked uvicorn marketory.main:app --reload --reload-dir apps/api/src --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000
scripts.api:test: uv run --project apps/api --locked pytest -c apps/api/pyproject.toml apps/api/tests
scripts.api:lint: uv run --project apps/api ruff check apps/api scripts/export_openapi.py
scripts.types:generate: uv run --project apps/api python scripts/export_openapi.py && openapi-typescript packages/types/openapi.json -o packages/types/src/api.d.ts
scripts.check: npm run assets:check && npm run types:check && npm run typecheck && npm run web:test && npm run api:lint && npm run api:test
